translated_title: Government Invests 2 Billion Pesos and Reinforces Strategy to Contain Sargassum in Quintana Roo: Sheinbaum
original_title: Gobierno invierte 2 mil mdp y refuerza estrategia para contener el sargazo en Quintana Roo: Sheinbaum
author: Alma E. Muñoz and Néstor Jiménez
meta_description: This year's sargassum influx is four times greater than 2025 and 27 times the historical average, with some 9,000 tons washing onto Quintana Roo's beaches every day.
